title: Single-setup levelling, height-of-instrument reduction (NAVEDTRA 14069, p. 14-10; case C9)

source.citation: US Navy, Engineering Aid, NAVEDTRA 14069, chapter 14, single-setup example

verification: Exact rational arithmetic: 365.01 + 11.56 = 376.57; 376.57 - 1.42 = 375.15. SOURCE ERRATUM, recorded in planning/REFERENCE_CASES.md: the text prints the backsight as 11.65 ft, but its own arithmetic (and the printed height of instrument 376.57) uses 11.56. The request uses 11.56; with the printed 11.65 the result would be 376.66 and 375.24, which is not what the book states. Tolerance 0.005 ft is half the last printed digit (two decimals).
